zh-CN.title: 猫咪招呼更醒目了
items: Niko 与 Fufu 现在统一从头像框底部中央钻出
猫咪尺寸扩大一倍，挥手动作更加清晰醒目
完整 8 帧动画仍保持每 10 秒播放一次

en.title: Bolder cat greetings
items: Niko and Fufu now emerge from the bottom center of the avatar frame
Both cats are twice as large, making every wave clearer and more expressive
The complete eight-frame greeting still plays once every 10 seconds
